title: FILM GRAIN AND A BAKED VIGNETTE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 8 (the post pass), in the gritty grounded look he chose. The picture gets a fine film grain over the world that shifts 24 times a second, the way ARC Raiders reads, and it never lifts what is under the fog. The dark vignette at the screen edge looks the same but is now painted once and reused instead of being rebuilt every frame. POST FX OFF or EFFECT INTENSITY OFF removes the grain. Nothing about play changes.
now: The world has a fine film grain (POST FX and EFFECT INTENSITY turn it off) and the edge vignette is painted once.
